profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's primary public-facing product is Claude, which it describes as an AI built for problem solvers, capable of tackling complex challenges, analyzing data, and writing code. Anthropic also offers the Anthropic Console, a developer-facing platform for API management, prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, and a Computer Use agent designed for desktop automation and computer control tasks.

Anthropic faces a substantial volume of litigation. Twelve cases appear in the held facts, spanning multiple federal courts including the Northern District of California, the District of Delaware, the District of Hawaii, the District of Vermont, the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, and the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Cases include actions brought by Edelson PC, the University of Tennessee Research Foundation, and several individual plaintiffs. The held facts record 181 instances of legal exposure coded to California. Anthropic's products also appear in at least one registered MCP server, an LLM orchestration agent built on Langchain and Anthropic's models, listed under the identifier ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic.
